documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: PAN Card Registration, Correction & Other Service 2026
postName: Permanent Account Number (PAN) – Apply, Correct, Reprint
vacancyDetails: Online PAN application (Form 49A/49AA), correction/change request and reprint services
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.incometax.gov.in or https://www.onlineservices.nsdl.com/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html
2. Choose New PAN / Changes or Correction / Reprint
3. Fill Form 49A (Indian citizens) or 49AA (foreign)
4. Upload documents and photo/sign
5. Pay fee and track acknowledgement e-PAN
shortDescription: PAN Card online registration, correction and reprint services 2026 – apply via Income Tax / NSDL / UTIITSL portals.
content:
Permanent Account Number (PAN) services are available online through the Income Tax Department and authorised agencies (NSDL e-Gov / UTIITSL).

Services

  • New PAN application
  • Correction / change in PAN data
  • Reprint of PAN card / e-PAN download

Use only official portals. Keep Aadhaar, proof of identity, address and date of birth ready. e-PAN is also available free in many cases via Income Tax e-Filing.
